{{Quote|The royal family wanted to heal relations between the Rift Alliance and the Republic, they thought donating troops would help. They planned a ceremony on Waypoint Station Three to present you with the soldiers. But you where needed on Hoth... so I sent Blaesus as our envoy. He's with the king and queen right now.|Senator [[Tobas Grell]]|<ref name="TOR:CtL">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Chasing the Legend|Hoth}}</ref>}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]] was ruled by a '''royal family''' by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sethun]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nyscha]] were the rulers of the planet.<ref name="TOR:TStK" />
